Five months after Taylor Swift caused a stir by sitting courtside at the NBA Finals, New York Knicks superstar Jalen Brunson is hoping to put an end to the drama once and for all.  

Brunson, 30, exclusively told Us that Swift, 36, is “obviously” welcome at Knicks’ games weeks after the point guard’s teammate, Tyler Kolek , said Swift’s support of the team was “performative” during an NBA 2K livestream on November 5. 

“I can’t believe I have to say this,” Brunson said via his partnership with Lowe’s. “But I didn’t say what was said. Being one of the leaders of the team — the captain of the team — I guess I now have to help somebody out. Yes, she’s a member of the Knicks fandom. Yes, she is.” 

Swift attended Game 4 of the 2026 NBA Finals in June, sitting courtside with friends Mariska Hargitay and Alana and Este Haim .

After winning the NBA title, Brunson issued a message of support for McNutt.  

“I just want to say something to the Swifties: She’s a really good one,” he said at the time. “Cut her some slack. It’s all good, I promise.” 

With the holidays approaching, Jalen explained how he and his wife, Ali , have formulated traditions with their daughter Jordyn , 2, in a multi-religion household.

In Us ‘ exclusive first look at the opening for the Monday, November 30, episode of the Fox series, Lynch, 66, is joined by several lifeguards wearing the squad’s signature color of red in a slow-motion sequence set to “I’m Always Here” by Jimi Jamison .

Lynch, who hosts the show, even took one for the team by letting herself be drenched in water, saying, “That’s a lot of water.”

Celebrity Weakest Link will celebrate the show by reuniting Kelly Packard, Nicole Eggert, Michael Bergin, Alexandra Paul, Traci Bingham, David Chokachi, Gregory Alan Williams and Gena Lee Nolin as they compete against each other to win money for their selected charities.

What to Know About 'Baywatch' Reboot — Including Which OG Stars Are Returning 

Baywatch centered around the lives of lifeguards who worked on California (and Hawaii) beaches while dealing with a variety of situations including earthquakes, shark attacks and serial killers. At one point during its run in the ’90s, Baywatch made history as the most-watched television series in the world.

The series had dozens of cast shakeups over the years but ultimately turned into a cultural phenomenon . Some of the show’s memorable cast members include Eggert, 54, Carmen Electra, David Hasselhoff, Billy Warlock, Jeremy Jackson and Erika Eleniak .

items.title: Barbara Eden, 95, Breaks Down Her Fitness Routine Away From the Gym
items.summary:
Barbara Eden ’s secret to looking and feeling great at the age of 95 involves some quality time with a personal trainer.

“I go for about, I don’t know, 35 minutes on the bike. It’s good,” Eden shared with Fox News Digital in an interview published on Sunday, November 22. “I don’t go to the gym anymore.”

When she did, the I Dream of Jeannie actress committed to a “spinning class for an hour, and then I worked with a trainer for a half hour, lifting weights.”

These days, Eden still lifts weights because she believes it’s especially good for women and their bones.

Lindsay Lohan Reveals Her Skincare Beauty Secrets: ‘Everyone Does Botox’ 

“You have to be disciplined about being active when you’re an actor,” she said with a laugh. “My husband [of 35 years, Jon Eicholtz ] and I both have a trainer that comes in and helps us out.”

As any wellness expert would argue, fitness is only part of the equation to staying healthy. Diet is also important to longevity.

Eden said she is careful about what she eats, “but I’m not overly stupid about it, you know?”

“I’ve never smoked. I don’t know if that means anything. But I think one of the things that’s most important in your life is that you recognize other people,” she said. “You realize that they’re not so different than you are, and you have to get along. And when you do that, you find life is much more interesting, and people are much more interesting.”

Eden became a household name when she starred in I Dream of Jeannie from 1965 to 1970. She also guest starred in projects like Sabrina the Teenage Witch and George Lopez .

As…
items.t: Barbara Eden, 95, Breaks Down Her Fitness Routine Away From the Gym

items.title: Boy Was ‘Begging for His Life’ Before Father Killed Family in Murder-Suicide
items.summary:
Authorities in Florida revealed additional heartbreaking details of a 911 call before a father killed his wife and three young children in a murder-suicide.

The Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office confirmed that Isaac Luechtefeld , and his wife, Raquel Luechtefeld , were found dead alongside their children, Enoch, 5, Hannah, 3, and Job, 1, at their home in Plant City, Florida, on Thursday, November 19.

Investigators said they believe Isaac, 34, fatally shot his family inside their home before he died by suicide.

Dispatchers received a 911 call from the home around 3:30 p.m. on Thursday and reported hearing gunshots in the background.

Estranged Husband Allegedly Killed Wife in Murder-Suicide While Kids Were Home 

“It’s an open line, and we can hear a male’s voice say, ‘Sorry, buddy.’ And we hear a loud bang,” Hillsborough County Sheriff Chad Chronister said during a news conference on Thursday.

An open-line call connects to 911 without the caller speaking, which allows dispatchers to hear background noises.

“In the distance, we can hear a small child begging for his life,” Chronister continued.

The child was then heard begging his father to spare his life. “Daddy, please don’t shoot me. Daddy, please don’t kill me,” the sheriff said of the child’s pleas.

Chronister said that the child repeated the pleas three or four times before dispatchers said they heard another loud bang.

Deputies arrived at the home just 11 minutes after the 911 call came through at 3:40 p.m. Once they got to the home, officers spotted one of the children lying lifeless on the floor and they…
items.t: Boy Was ‘Begging for His Life’ Before Father Killed Family in Murder-Suicide

items.title: ESPN's Tom Jackson Had Health Dilemma Before His ‘Unexpected’ Death at 75
items.summary:
Legendary ESPN broadcaster and former NFL star Tom Jackson was considering surgery before his sudden death on Friday, November 20. 

Jackson’s death was “unexpected,” according to his former Denver Broncos teammate Bob Swenson .  

“I talked to him every week, sometimes every day,” Swenson, 73, told the Denver Gazette ’s Chris Tomasson on Sunday, November 22. “I talked to him, and he was going back and forth about getting a back operation, and then he said he was going to do it. Then I texted him, but I wasn’t getting a response the last couple of days.” 

Swenson added, “He just said he was going to do the back surgery and he had some things going on with his leg. I was just waiting to hear back. I texted him, ‘Are you OK?’ I think I texted him on Thursday and Friday and no response. … I was just stunned.” 

49ers Share Update After Colton McKivitz Suffers Grotesque Injury on ‘SNF' 

An official cause of death has not been released. Jackson was 75. 

A member of the Broncos’ formidable “Orange Crush” defense, Jackson helped lead Denver to Super Bowl appearances 1978 and 1987. Jackson played all 14 of his NFL seasons with the Broncos before retiring at the conclusion of the 1987 season. He was named a First-Team All-Pro in 1977 and a three-time Pro Bowler in three consecutive seasons from 1977 to 1979.  

ESPN commentator Tom Jackson on Monday Night Football on November 13, 2006. Al Messerschmidt/Getty Images 
 For a younger generation, Jackson became well-known for his broadcasting career after joining ESPN in 1987. Jackson and broadcast partner Chris Berman became an…
items.t: ESPN's Tom Jackson Had Health Dilemma Before His ‘Unexpected’ Death at 75

items.title: DWTS’ Derek Hough Alludes to Childhood Sexual Abuse in New Doc
items.summary:
Dancing With the Stars judge Derek Hough is opening up about dark moments in his childhood in his new documentary, The Symphony of Dance. 

Hough, 41, shared in the film, streaming now on Disney+, that dance became his “safe haven” growing up in Utah.

“Derek was my only boy, and he was a bundle of energy. Some of the family videos you look back and start laughing because he just had to be moving,” Derek’s father, Bruce Hough , said in the doc. “You could not look at Derek without wanting to smile. He somehow always managed to put a positive face on things. And he had a lot of things in his life that were traumatizing and difficult.”

Derek reflected on having neighbors who “weren’t great” to him or his family — which includes current DWTS cohost Julianne Hough. 

‘DWTS’ at 20: Derek and Julianne Hough Get Tearful About Why It's 'Home' 

“They pretty much terrorized my family in a lot of ways,” he recalled. “They hung me up in a tree by my ankles, like, put a gun to my head, spat on me, hogtied me up in a field and left me there.”

Derek went on to seemingly allude to one person sexually abusing him. “And then one of my neighbors was, for lack of a better word, just really inappropriate with me physically,” he said.

Amy Sussman/Getty Images 
 After Derek’s parents got divorced, the pair moved into separate apartments across from each other and the children spent time in both locations. Derek shared that he felt “relieved” to leave his neighborhood but said it was a chapter of “uncertainty” for him.

items.title: Man Charged With Murder in Shooting of Texas Mom of 4 on Her 35th Birthday
items.summary:
A man was arrested in the killing of a Texas woman who was fatally shot along a freeway while driving home from work on her 35th birthday.

Juan Gonzalez-Orduna was booked in jail on a murder charge on Sunday, November 22, in connection with the November 15 death of Stephanie Gonzalez , the Dallas Police Department said in a new statement .

Gonzalez was shot after she had been involved in a crash on the C.F. Hawn Freeway in Dallas the evening of November 15, police said in an initial statement. She died of her injuries at a hospital.

Before Gonzalez-Orduna’s arrest, Gonzalez’s family said they believed she had been targeted because of the timing of the killing, which occurred on her birthday as she headed home to her four children.

Man Told Texas Cops He Killed His Wife So He Could Start a 'New Life' With GF 

Gonzalez’s cousin Vivian Britton told NBC DFW that Gonzalez had been about 10 minutes away from her house when she was killed after a day of work at Quality Sausage Company in West Dallas, where she was a company supervisor.

“She was on her way home to see her babies,” Britton said of Gonzalez’s children, which includes a baby who is just a few months old.

Gonzalez-Orduna, 29, has been detained at the Lew Sterrett Jail, where he’s also being held on an immigration hold over his alleged illegal immigration status, records show.

It wasn’t immediately clear whether Gonzalez-Orduna had an attorney who could comment on his behalf.

Dallas police haven’t specified a potential motive for Gonzalez’s killing.

Gonzalez “was a loving daughter, wife, mother, sister, aunt,…

items.title: 'Law & Order' Alum E.J. Carroll's Cause of Death Revealed After Collapse
items.summary:
Law & Order alum E.J. Carroll ’s cause of death has been revealed after he collapsed in the streets of New York City on his way to a voiceover job.

Carroll died of a pulmonary embolism, his manager, Jon Mason , confirmed to Us . He was 66.

Us understands that Carroll recently underwent major surgery to correct a hernia issue. He had taken great lengths to improve his health before his death, including weight loss throughout his career.

Carroll was recovering from his surgery while on his way to a voiceover gig to add dialogue to a commercial he recently filmed with New York Knicks player Jalen Brunson and actress Quinta Brunson . He collapsed on the street en route to the job on Thursday, November 19.

A memorial service will be held in NYC on December 5.

Celebrity Deaths of 2026: E.J. Carroll, Lance Broadway and More 

Mason confirmed Carroll’s death in a statement shared on Saturday, November 21.

“When E.J. Carroll performed, it was impossible to take your eyes off him,” he said. “But his lasting legacy will be the kindness and generosity he showed his friends, fellow performers and even strangers.”

Mason added that Carroll was “as good a human being as it gets.”

Carroll’s close friend Jayce Bartok remembered the actor in a statement to Us after working together on the upcoming film A Delicate Arrangement .

“E.J. was my closest friend for the past 20 years. I met him on the set of a film I wrote, The Cake Eaters starring Kristen Stewart and Bruce Dern. I was preparing for a very dramatic scene, and E.J. and I shared a van. He was so sweet and genuine, he became…
items.t: 'Law & Order' Alum E.J. Carroll's Cause of Death Revealed After Collapse

items.title: 9 People Injured During Mass Shooting at Concert Believed to Be Gang Related
items.summary:
Nine people were shot during a mass shooting at a private concert in California, and one person has been left in critical condition following the horrific incident.

The Tulare County Sheriff’s Office announced in a press release that the shooting broke out around 7:40 p.m. on Saturday, November 21, at a concert in Strathmore, California.

Officials said that an unspecified number of suspects started shooting at the crowd. No arrests have been announced as of time of publication.

One of the victims who was shot was a 26-year-old man, who was reportedly struck in the chest. He sustained severe injuries, which required him to undergo surgery. Officials said that the victim is currently in critical condition.

Children, Adults Found Dead After 911 Call About 'Booby Traps' at CA Home 

The sheriff’s office added that two other victims – who are 19 and 22 years old – also underwent surgery, while six people sustained minor injuries in the shooting.

“Initial reports indicated that the suspects opened fire into the crowd, hitting at least nine people. When Deputies arrived, they immediately began rendering first aid to the victims, while several others drove themselves to local hospitals for treatment,” the sheriff’s office wrote in a follow-up press release .

Authorities said that the shooting “may be gang-related,” but they did not elaborate on the theory or share if they have any suspects on their radar.

items.title: Which Past Characters Would Lindsay Lohan Spend Holidays With?
items.summary:
If Lindsay Lohan could ring in the holiday season with one of her former beloved characters, she has one — or two — from an iconic film in mind.

“The best would be to have the best of both worlds, which would be Hallie and Annie, because then you’d be in London with all those Christmas lights, and then you’d be in Napa in this beautiful vineyard setting,” Lohan, 40, exclusively told Us of her Parent Trap characters while celebrating the launch of her Marshalls Unwrap the Internet partnership.

Lohan famously portrayed long-lost identical twin sisters in the 1998 remake, with Hallie and Annie growing up with their separated parents in Napa Valley, California, and London, respectively. The movie, directed by Nancy Meyers , followed the girls meeting at a summer sleepaway camp before switching places in a ruse to bring their parents (played by Dennis Quaid and the late Natasha Richardson ) back together.

“I would definitely choose them because then you get two for one,” Lohan said to Us . “And that’s also like a Nancy Meyers Christmas. So you can’t really say no to that.”

Due to the severity of the injury, McKivitz, 30, will almost assuredly miss the rest of the season.

Players from both teams were noticeably upset, with 49ers left tackle Trent Williams slamming his helmet to the ground.
